title: The Dog Sitter Show
description: Whenever Domber’s owner goes on holiday, the dreaded dog sitter pays him a visit.
quote: I’ve told you a hundred times, don’t eat the door.
altHero: Domber the dog with his pet sitter, a blonde man giving a thumbs up
alt1: Domber and his pet sitter stand in the doorway
alt3: the pet sitter winking at the camera
alt4: the pet sitter laughing at Domber who has dog food poured all over his face and a broom stuck to his bum
